meta.name: oss-standards
meta.description: Pre-PR discipline for a public-by-default repo. What a reviewer enforces beyond CI: secrets and internal data in diffs or screenshots, docs that name their reader, and the cleaning pass where incomplete or confusing artifacts get dropped. Use before opening any PR against `gridaco/grida` or when finalizing work for review.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在提交 PR 前自动检查机密泄露和文档质量
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在维护公开仓库，需要在 PR 前做人工审查之外的自动化检查。
copy.tagline_en: Automatically check for secrets and doc quality before opening a PR
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you maintain a public repo and need automated checks beyond CI before PR review.

howto.what: Claude 会检查你的代码和文档，确保没有泄露密钥、内部链接或截图中的敏感信息；要求文档明确说明目标读者；并删除不完整或令人困惑的内容。
howto.when: 在向 `gridaco/grida` 仓库提交 PR 之前，或准备代码供审查时触发。

say.text: 帮我检查这个 PR 有没有泄露密钥或内部信息。
say.note: Claude 会扫描 diff 和截图中的敏感数据。

say.text: 这篇文档的目标读者是谁？帮我写清楚。
say.note: Claude 会要求你明确读者，并调整措辞。

say.text: 清理这个 PR 中不完整或多余的文件。
say.note: Claude 会删除临时文件、半成品等。

howto.what_en: Claude checks your code and docs for leaked secrets, internal URLs, or sensitive data in screenshots; requires docs to name their reader; and drops incomplete or confusing artifacts.
howto.when_en: Triggered before opening a PR against `gridaco/grida` or when finalizing work for review.

say_en.text: Check this PR for leaked secrets or internal info.
say_en.note: Claude scans diffs and screenshots for sensitive data.

say_en.text: Who is the reader of this doc? Help me clarify.
say_en.note: Claude asks you to name the audience and adjust wording.

say_en.text: Clean up incomplete or unnecessary files in this PR.
say_en.note: Claude removes temp files, half-written docs, etc.
